title: Cleaning Procedure Method Statement
description: Free Cleaning Procedure Method Statement template for manufacturing you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers 1.0 safety & preparation, 2.0 cleaning agents & equipment, 3.0 cleaning procedure.

3.0 Cleaning Procedure

PhaseActions
DRY CLEANING• Remove loose debris/dust
• Sweep or vacuum area
• Dispose of waste properly
• Remove portable items if necessary
• Protect sensitive equipment
WET CLEANING• Prepare cleaning solution per instructions
• Apply cleaning agent (method: ______________)
• Allow appropriate contact time
• Agitate/scrub as needed
• Rinse thoroughly
• Remove standing water
SANITIZATION• Apply sanitizer (if required)
• Concentration: ______________ ppm
• Contact time: ______________ minutes
• Air dry or wipe dry
DETAIL CLEANING• Clean hard-to-reach areas
• Clean corners, edges, crevices
• Wipe down vertical surfaces
• Clean lighting fixtures
• Address any stained/spotted areas

4.0 Specialized Cleaning Tasks

EquipmentRequirements
Conveyors• Clean belts/tracks
• Remove buildup from rollers
• Clean underneath conveyor
• Check and clean sensors
Machines• Remove chips/debris
• Wipe down exterior surfaces
• Clean windows/guards
• Vacuum electrical panels (if qualified)
Floors• Remove oil/grease spots
• Apply floor cleaner
• Scrub thoroughly
• Rinse and dry
• Apply floor finish if required
Walls/Ceilings• Dust surfaces
• Wash if required
• Check for damage
• Report any issues
